about: Hawkesbury is a town on the Ottawa River in Prescott-Russell, Ontario, facing Grenville, Quebec, about midway between Ottawa and Montréal. A strongly bilingual mill town, it grew around pulp and paper and the Long-Sault corridor. Chenail Island and a compact downtown sit at a historic river crossing. About 10,000 people live in Hawkesbury.
seoSummary: Bilingual Ottawa River town facing Grenville, Quebec—mill-town heritage and Chenail Island, not a big city.
